Getting started

Install the compiler, write one page, build it.

pnpm add -D @reactogenic/cli @reactogenic/core
npm install -D @reactogenic/cli @reactogenic/core

Your first page#

Reactogenic compiles the shell of every page once. The layout components run in the compiler and leave plain HTML behind, so paragraph 1 of this page costs exactly its own bytes and nothing else.

Reactogenic compiles the shell of every page once. The layout components run in the compiler and leave plain HTML behind, so paragraph 2 of this page costs exactly its own bytes and nothing else.

import { Page, SideMenu } from "@reactogenic/core";

export default function Index() {
  return (
    <Page layout="docs">
      <$Aside><SideMenu collapsible /></$Aside>
      // your content
    </Page>
  );
}

Note

The shell is compiled once per pathname. Nothing in it may be conditional.

Build#

Run reactogenic build. Press / to search these docs.

  • One HTML file per page.
  • One CSS payload per page, holding only the rules that page can use.
  • Raw JS only for the behaviours on the page.
